description: Cyclone Seroja DRFA Activated LGAs April 2021 is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Drought and North Queensland Flood Response and Recovery Agency. These Local Government Areas (LGA) have been declared disaster areas and activated under the joint Commonwealth-State Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements (DRFA) due to Cyclone Seroja flooding and wind damage in south-west Western Australia, 11-12 April 2021. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher National Drought and North Queensland Flood Response and Recovery Agency. Its tags are Cyclone, Regional Recovery, Western Australia, flood, severe weather. It offers 6 resource(s) in esri shapefile - zipped, geojson, pdf, sld, wfs. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
